title: Grade 6 Math — Wed, Jun 11
description: Basic Geometry — Day 3 of 5: Measuring angles; complementary and supplementary
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Two angles that add up to 90° are called ___.
Two angles that add up to 180° are called ___.
If one angle is 35°, its complement is ___.
If one angle is 110°, its supplement is ___.
Which pair of angles are complementary?
Which pair of angles are supplementary?
Angles on a straight line add up to ___.
questions.explanation: A straight line is a straight angle = 180°. Any angles formed on it must total 180°.

questions.question: If two adjacent angles on a straight line are equal, each is ___.
questions.explanation: Equal angles on a straight line: each = 180° ÷ 2 = 90° (right angles).

questions.question: Angles around a point add up to ___.
questions.explanation: All angles around a complete point sum to 360°.

questions.question: An angle of 75° has a complement of ___.
An angle of 45° has a supplement of ___.
Three angles on a straight line measure 60°, 70°, and x°. What is x?
Vertically opposite angles (formed when two lines cross) are ___.
questions.explanation: When two lines cross, opposite angles are equal — these are called vertically opposite angles.

questions.question: Two lines cross. One angle formed is 65°. What is the vertically opposite angle?
questions.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are equal. So the opposite angle is also 65°.

questions.question: Two angles on a straight line measure (2x)° and (3x)°. Find x.
